content.value_statement: Engineering teams need clear evidence before choosing a framework, database, cloud provider, or migration path. This skill turns stack options into structured comparisons, cost estimates, security notes, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Compares frameworks, databases, languages, cloud providers, and full technology stacks.
Builds weighted decision matrices for user-defined priorities and use cases.
Estimates total cost of ownership across licensing, hosting, productivity, and scaling factors.
Assesses ecosystem health, maintenance signals, documentation quality, and long-term viability.
Reviews security and compliance readiness for requirements such as SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI-DSS.
Produces migration complexity estimates, timelines, risks, and mitigation guidance.
limitations: Results depend on the accuracy and completeness of the user-provided context.
Real-time ecosystem or vulnerability data may require users to provide current metrics or links.
Cost estimates are directional and should be validated against vendor pricing and internal labor rates.
The skill supports decision analysis but does not replace architecture review or security sign-off.

use_cases.title: Compare frontend frameworks
use_cases.description: Compare React, Vue, Angular, or Svelte against team skills, product needs, maintainability, and ecosystem maturity.

use_cases.title: Select a cloud provider
use_cases.description: Evaluate AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud for workload fit, cost drivers, compliance needs, operational effort, and migration risk.

use_cases.title: Plan a legacy migration
use_cases.description: Estimate complexity, risk, sequencing, and expected benefits when moving from an older stack to a modern replacement.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two technologies
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare React and Vue for a SaaS dashboard. Focus on developer productivity, ecosystem maturity, performance, and hiring.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a complete stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this stack for a real-time collaboration product: Node.js, WebSockets, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Include strengths, risks, and recommendation confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate total cost of ownership
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate a five-year TCO comparison for AWS and Azure for 50 compute instances, 10 TB storage, high bandwidth, and a team of six engineers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a migration strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess migration from AngularJS to React for a 50,000-line application with 200 components. Include risk, timeline, phased approach, and decision criteria.

output_examples.input: Compare PostgreSQL and MongoDB for a financial reporting application.
output: Recommendation with confidence level and key assumptions.
Decision matrix covering consistency, query needs, operations, compliance, and team fit.
Risks, tradeoffs, and next validation steps.

output_examples.input: Evaluate AWS versus Azure for a regulated healthcare workload.
output: Cloud provider scorecard by compliance, services, cost, operations, and ecosystem.
Estimated cost drivers and security considerations.
Practical recommendation with conditions that could change the decision.

output_examples.input: Assess migration from a monolith to microservices.
output: Migration complexity summary and risk level.
Phased migration plan with expected effort and dependencies.
Mitigations for downtime, data consistency, and operational readiness.

best_practices: Provide the use case, scale, team experience, compliance needs, and decision priorities.
Ask for weighted criteria when stakeholders disagree about what matters most.
Validate recommendations with current vendor pricing, benchmarks, and internal operational data.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic best technology without explaining the workload and constraints.
Do not treat directional TCO estimates as final procurement numbers.
Do not ignore migration risk when a new stack scores higher on features alone.

faq.question: Can this skill compare more than two technologies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare multiple frameworks, databases, cloud providers, or full stacks in one decision matrix.

faq.question: Does it use live data from GitHub, npm, or CVE sources?
faq.answer: It can analyze URLs and documented metrics, but users should verify current values when live access is unavailable.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance decisions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess readiness for requirements such as GDPR, SOC2, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS at a planning level.

faq.question: Is the cost analysis exact?
faq.answer: No. TCO outputs are estimates based on assumptions and should be checked against vendor quotes and internal rates.

faq.question: Can it produce executive summaries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate short recommendation summaries and detailed breakdowns for technical review.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
